values.note: RV/camper site $45 a night, tent site $35; firewood $7. A Metroparks daily ($10) or annual vehicle pass is required, not included in the reservation, and a daily pass must be bought again on re-entry. Cancellation at least 24 hours out refunds less one night's fee.

fees.source: https://www.metroparks.com/lower-huron-metropark/ ('Tent Site (per night): $35 / RV/Camper Site (per night): $45'; 'Park Fees: $10 Daily or Annual Vehicle Pass'; 'if you leave the park and re-enter, you will need a new daily pass') + 2026 campground rules PDF ('Park entry fees are not included in the reservation fee'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.metroparks.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/2026-LH-Walnut-Grove-Campground-Map.pdf (legend: 'TENT, POP-UP OR RV Has water, sewer hookups & 50/30/20 amp electric'; 'TENT OR POP-UP Has water & 30/20 amp electric'), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://www.metroparks.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/2026-LH-Walnut-Grove-Campground-Map.pdf ('CAMPSITES (30)') + park page ('Thirty campsites'), read 2026-10-22. The 40-ft max_rig_ft rested only on reviewer reports; the Metroparks pages give no length, so it is cleared.

facilities.source: https://www.metroparks.com/lower-huron-metropark/ ('No showers available'; 'A sanitary dump station is available on-site') + 2026 campground map ('WATER JUG FILLER', 'RV DUMP STATION'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Sites can be reserved early May through mid-October.

season.source: https://www.metroparks.com/lower-huron-metropark/ ('Thirty campsites are located near the Huron River and can be reserved early May through mid-October'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Book online (Huron-Clinton Metroparks WebTrac) or through the Willow Metropark office (734) 697-9181; ADA campsites are first come, first served. A stay may not exceed 14 consecutive days, then 5 days out. Check-in 1 pm, check-out 11 am.

booking.source: https://www.metroparks.com/lower-huron-metropark/ ('Click here to make your reservation online'; 'ADA campsites available, first come, first served') + 2026 campground rules PDF ('A single camping stay may not exceed fourteen (14) consecutive days'; 'Check-in time is 1:00 p.m. ... check out by 11 a.m.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Huron-Clinton Metroparks (regional authority) campground in Lower Huron Metropark, on the Huron River near Belleville; modern restrooms, near the Turtle Cove aquatic center and the hike-bike trail. Reviewers fit 40-ft and 31-ft rigs fine. Renovated and reopened 2023. --Claude
summary: Metroparks park page, 2026 campground map and 2026 rules confirm 30 sites, RV sites with water, sewer and 50/30/20-amp electric, no showers, dump station and jug filler, $45 RV / $35 tent, $10 daily vehicle pass extra, reservable online early May-mid-October, 14-night maximum, ADA sites FCFS. Added hookups, entrance fee, booking url/fcfs/max stay, season note; cleared reviewer-only max_rig_ft 40. Note trimmed of hookup, booking, season, price and pass text (the 'some reviewers report no hookups' line is contradicted by the map). Entry has no phone: the park office is (734) 697-9181.
